verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Asaas Checkout, where data is entered on a page controlled by Asaas, and server-side API calls that can process card payments. It does not document any embeddable, customizable UI payment components such as drop-in card fields or widgets. A raw card-processing API is a developer building block, not the embedded-component capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page
